emails.subject: rotational sales workflows across business units
emails.body:
Cummins offers a two-year Marketing and Sales development program across U.K. and European business units.

When reps move through four six-month assignments across divisions, pipeline context and account history often get fractured between siloed tools.

At Salesforce, we help enterprise teams consolidate sales workflows and customer data onto a single platform.

When reps switch between business units, what breaks first in tracking customer context across divisions?

Best regards,
agnesh_mp@pg27.mesaschool.co

emails.subject: phased platform launches and customer tracking
emails.body:
When global industrial manufacturers launch new engine platforms in phases, sales and service visibility often breaks down across business units.

When customer inquiries, pipeline updates, and account data live in separate regional tools, account teams usually lose sight of cross-unit demand during early launch phases.

Does disjointed customer tracking across divisions during new product rollouts match your experience at Cummins, or are your teams already aligned on a single platform?

Best regards,
agnesh_mp@pg27.mesaschool.co
emails.trigger_used: Cummins announced a phased launch plan on August 10, 2026, for its Model Year 2027 X10 and X15 engine platforms.
emails.trigger_link: Executing phased product rollouts across divisions requires a unified CRM and analytics platform to keep customer tracking aligned.

emails.subject: emerging digital tools and commercial workflows
emails.body:
Cummins recently joined Emerald Technology Ventures as a Limited Partner to expand access to digital tools and emerging technologies.

As you evaluate new technologies, connecting customer records and automated workflows across divisions requires a centralized platform. Salesforce unifies customer data, AI agents, and analytics.

If we brought you a simple view of how enterprise teams unify sales workflows and automated AI agents without disrupting existing systems, would you be open to looking at it? No cost or commitment attached.

Best regards,
agnesh_mp@pg27.mesaschool.co
